import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# Color palette
fraud_colors = ['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c']

# 1. Fraud distribution by transaction type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
fraud_by_type = pd.crosstab(df['transaction_type'], df['is_fraud'], normalize='index') * 100
fraud_by_type.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=fraud_colors, width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax1.legend(['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], title='Transaction Status')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction amount distribution by fraud status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
df_fraud = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount']
df_legit = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount']
positions = [1, 2]
bp = ax2.boxplot([df_legit, df_fraud], positions=positions, widths=0.6, 
                   patch_artist=True, labels=['Legitimate', 'Fraud'])
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], fraud_colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Status', fontsize=10)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fraud transactions by hour of day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
fraud_by_hour = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
fraud_by_hour['fraud_rate'] = (fraud_by_hour['sum'] / fraud_by_hour['count']) * 100
fraud_by_hour['fraud_count'] = fraud_by_hour['sum']

ax3_twin = ax3.twinx()
bars = ax3.bar(fraud_by_hour.index, fraud_by_hour['fraud_count'], 
               color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.6, label='Fraud Count')
line = ax3_twin.plot(fraud_by_hour.index, fraud_by_hour['fraud_rate'], 
                     color='#3498db', marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=4, 
                     label='Fraud Rate (%)')

ax3.set_title('Fraud Activity by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Fraud Cases', fontsize=10, color='#e74c3c')
ax3_twin.set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=10, color='#3498db')
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#e74c3c')
ax3_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#3498db')
ax3.set_xlim(-0.5, 23.5)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Overall fraud statistics
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
ax4.axis('off')

# Calculate statistics
total_transactions = len(df)
fraud_transactions = df['is_fraud'].sum()
fraud_rate = (fraud_transactions / total_transactions) * 100
avg_amount_fraud = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount'].mean()
avg_amount_legit = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount'].mean()
fraud_by_type_counts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['transaction_type'].value_counts()

stats_text = f"""
Overall Statistics:

Total Transactions: {total_transactions:,}
Fraudulent Transactions: {fraud_transactions:,}
Fraud Rate: {fraud_rate:.2f}%

Average Transaction Amount:
  • Legitimate: ${avg_amount_legit:.2f}
  • Fraudulent: ${avg_amount_fraud:.2f}

Fraud by Transaction Type:
"""

for trans_type, count in fraud_by_type_counts.items():
    stats_text += f"  • {trans_type.capitalize()}: {count}\n"

ax4.text(0.1, 0.5, stats_text, fontsize=11, family='monospace',
         verticalalignment='center', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', 
         facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.3))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
